question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Water pollution not **__only endangers__** human health but also our environment.
solution:
The correct answer is **"only harms​​."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"endangers"** means to cause danger to somebody/something. ((व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) ख़तरे में डालना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Smoking **endangers**__ your health.*
 
 
 
• The word that can replace **"endangers" **is **"harms."**
 
• The word** "harms" **means to cause injury or damage; hurt. (चोट या क्षति पहुँचाना; नुक़सान करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Too much sunshine can **harm**__ your skin.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

37:Tbc7,
The correct answer is 'Option 1'</
